8.3.14.en:
Deleting an adapter in a multihost system deletes it also on the other running hosts that hold its package but no longer need it: each host is asked with `getAdapterUsage` (js-controller 8.0 and newer), which also knows the packages a host keeps for the web extension of an instance on another host. A host that does not run or does not answer keeps the package. `iobroker del` on the command line still deletes on its own host only
The dialog "Write value" shows how big a string or JSON value is
Fixed: in the dialog "Write value" the value type was empty for JSON values and the type "JSON/Object" did not open the JSON editor
Instances can get the log level "off" (no log at all, not even errors), if js-controller 8 runs on their host
Updated @iobroker/json-config to 10.1.23: `selectSendTo` shows a text field instead of an endless spinner when the instance gives no list, `autocompleteSendTo` shows its `options`; the dialog of `diskSelector` comes from @iobroker/gui-components
Updated @iobroker/gui-components to 10.4.7: new dialog `DialogSelectDiskPath` (file or folder on the disk of a host); the description of a CRON schedule is shown in Portuguese, Dutch and Chinese instead of English
Overview: the panels have the same color as the tiles of the quick access
Fixed: a `sendTo` button in the configuration showed a success after 30 s and lost the answer of an adapter that needed longer (#3737)
Updated @iobroker/socket-client to 5.7.0 (`callbackTimeout`) and @iobroker/json-config to 10.1.24 (`sendTo` timeout)
The device manager in the settings or a tab of an instance can be pinned to the navigation, like in the device manager tab (#3738)

Хост, который не работает или не отвечает, сохраняет пакет. `iobroker del` в командной строке по-прежнему удаляется только на своем хосте
